rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the design concentrates depth rather than spreading it: four pure entry points (topology.read, current.book, gs.apply, solve.fixed_point) hide the topology read, the exact-clip booking, the coupling-matrix map with three carried derivative families, and Newton-GMRES with a line search, each behind a single signature, with the reused helpers carried in as private helpers behind the one call site rather than re-exported.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the recurring duplicate classes are each bound to a single named owner to extend: the row scale to ConstraintPair.binding.scale surfaced by ConstraintRecord.scaled_residual (nova/equilibrium/constraint.py:237,1843, verified the binding carries scale and the record surfaces the scaled residual), the booked current moments to current.book (observation.py:295 re-pointed to a consumer), the moment-map derivative to gs.apply (forward.py:1239/1276/1292 carried, no second copy), polygon monomial integration to polygon_moments.py:141, the contour tree to contour_tree.py:384, and the GPFS receipt path to nova/database/filepath.py:62/134 (FilePath/repository_relative) rather than a repeated literal; the compile-count instrument is the existing scripts/h200_test_lane/cache_guard.py, not a new counter.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — supplied figures public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every section that adds surface names, in its own text, what it retires or merges — §2 retires Topology.read/read_with_connectivity and the design inventory's null/region authorities, §3 retires clipped_support_current_moments and the forward_operator support partition, §4 retires the ForwardFluxOperator map, §5 retires newton_krylov/picard/operator_request_body and the ladders/frozen-live split, §6 collapses SolveRoute (six members) and SupportClipMode to the one solve and removes the eight retired ForwardSolvePolicy fields, a net reduction of public surface consistent with the zero counts.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan names an existing owner for every new module and function it adds and, in §6, an explicit deletion list: topology.read replaces Topology.read/read_with_connectivity (nova/equilibrium/topology.py:1396,1376), current.book replaces clipped_support_current_moments (clip_quadrature.py:714) plus the support partition, gs.apply replaces the map ForwardFluxOperator performs (forward_operator.py:2323), solve.fixed_point replaces newton_krylov/picard/operator_request_body (fixed_point.py:5003,2874,972), and it cites reuse candidates (the single-site GMRES kernel fixed_point.py:2619, the backtracking helpers fixed_point.py:1147/1270/1333, the operand layouts forward_operator.py:147/159/187/2079/2122/2239, contour_tree.build_contour_tree, polygon_moments.polygon_monomial_moments) — all verified present; candidates with the wrong contract were withdrawn with reasons (Null2D/Null1D are mesh-flux stencil fitters, `_steepest_descent_promotion` chooses its own direction).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — every proposed module is stated to replace its owner rather than wrap it (§6: "gs.apply replaces the map ForwardFluxOperator performs today rather than wrapping it"; topology.py "replaced in place"; current.py/solve.py new and owning their functions), and the operators each layer forwards over (read, book, G@) are distinct machinery, not one owner behind several shells.
